name: Review feedback is validated before implementation

turns.user: A review comment claims that parseConfig can return null and asks you to add a defensive cast. You have not inspected the contract or code path. State what you will do next.

values: I will add the cast now

rubric: The assistant restates the review comment as a testable claim.
It inspects the cited contract and code path before accepting the claim.
It records Accept, Reject, or needs evidence before proposing implementation.
It does not implement the requested cast merely because a reviewer requested it.
